items.vendor_cap_exception: vLLM security advisories (two RCEs) readers must act on

claims.claim: eight vLLM advisories added to GitHub Advisory Database on 28 October, all fixed in 0.32.0
claims.quote: Advisory DB list (github.com/advisories?query=vllm): Oct 28 entries vvpg-rrww-wpmh, 8397-8qf6-f2gm, gq5q-89c7-vhvx, h3rc-j82p-2c3h, 6757-hggm-hp2w, q97c-p368-75c4, x567-49g5-p4cf, 542m-9234-8gvf = 8; each page: Patched version 0.32.0

claims.claim: GHSA-h3rc-j82p CVSS 8.1, affected below 0.32.0, EPS labelled image/png reaches Ghostscript, vulnerable Ghostscript needed
claims.quote: High 8.1; < 0.32.0; An EPS payload labeled image/png reached the host's Ghostscript executable ... Deployments without Ghostscript or with a build fixed for CVE-2024-29510 are not affected by this execution chain.

claims.claim: GHSA-6757-hggm 7.5, --mm-processor-cache-type shm, authenticated caller, unpickles attacker bytes even with VLLM_ALLOW_INSECURE_SERIALIZATION=0
claims.quote: When --mm-processor-cache-type shm is enabled ... does not require VLLM_ALLOW_INSECURE_SERIALIZATION=1 ... An ordinary authenticated inference caller can execute arbitrary Python in the worker process

claims.claim: other six: CORS default *, Phi-4 audio, DeepSeek-OCR and OOV token crashes; severities Low to Moderate
claims.quote: CORS: Low 3.4, allowed_origins defaulting to ["*"], no authentication unless --api-key or VLLM_API_KEY. Phi-4 audio, DeepSeek-OCR, OOV token: Moderate 6.5. Also x567 (Responses API trust gate bypass) and 542m (chat template thread-pool DoS): Moderate. Note the brief's 'rest are crashes and exposure' omits the two template advisories.
claims.fix: Six others are Low (CORS) and Moderate (five); two of them (GHSA-x567, GHSA-542m) are chat-template DoS issues, not named in the brief.

claims.claim: Upgrading to 0.32.0 also covers last week's code_revision fix
claims.quote: GHSA-h3rc-6mm3-gc2m (code_revision RCE, High 8.1): affected >= 0.7.3, < 0.31.0; patched 0.31.0; published to repo Oct 6, to Advisory DB Oct 27; requires --trust-remote-code
claims.fix: 0.32.0 does include it (fixed in 0.31.0), but it entered the Advisory DB on 27 Oct (repo publication 6 Oct), not 'last week', and only affects deployments with --trust-remote-code. Say 'yesterday's code_revision advisory (fixed in 0.31.0)'.

claims.claim: Stopgap: none listed for the two RCEs; hosts without Ghostscript or patched for CVE-2024-29510 not exposed
claims.quote: The page has no workarounds section. Deployments without Ghostscript or with a build fixed for CVE-2024-29510 are not affected by this execution chain. (GHSA-6757: no workarounds section.)

claims.claim: If compromised: not stated in the advisories
claims.quote: Searched GHSA-h3rc-j82p and GHSA-6757-hggm full pages: only 'upgrade to 0.32.0' and Pillow/Ghostscript version notes; no compromise indicators or incident-response steps
